Secondly, the improved LLE algorithm is employed to reduce data dimensionality, followed by classification using an SVM model. Finally, compared with three other feature reduction methods, Fisher's measure is used to assess the classification accuracy of all four algorithms, confirming a significant improvement in accuracy for our proposed method.

articleTitle: Form-finding of Tensegrity Structures via Force Density Matrix Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This study proposes a form-finding algorithm based on force density matrix decomposition for tensegrity structures. The only information required is node connection and component type. The process is divided into three parts. Firstly, the non-self-stressed tensegrity structure is transformed into a self-stressed tensegrity structure using the virtual component method. In the second part, the solution of force density is transformed into the minimum rank deficit problem of the force density matrix and equilibrium matrix, and the semi-positive qualitative condition is taken as the iteration constraint. The third part specifies a set of independent node coordinate vectors, and the structure is guided to converge quickly. The force density form-finding method avoids the judgment of structural potential energy and stiffness matrix. The numerical example shows that the proposed method can promptly converge and search for new configurations.

articleTitle: Vehicle Mounted Strapdown Inertial Coarse Alignment Algorithm for LMD-KPCA-WT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Accurate initial alignment is a key step for inertial navigation systems to achieve accurate navigation and localization. However, the coarse alignment process suffers from the problems of long time and low accuracy under the vibration of vehicle engine and people walking, which affects the accuracy and efficiency of initial alignment. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a coarse alignment strategy based on the Local mean decomposition (LMD) and Kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) and Wavelet transform (WT) method, which aims to reduce the interference factors of fiber optic gyroscope and accelerometer in the coarse alignment process, so as to reduce the time required for the coarse alignment process. The aim of the coarse alignment strategy is to reduce the interference factors of the fiber optic gyro and accelerometer during the coarse alignment process, so as to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the initial alignment. Through experimental verification, the accuracy of yaw is improved by 65.09% after adopting this method in the case of serious external interference, which demonstrates the effectiveness and feasibility of this method. This research result is of great significance for improving the accuracy and reliability of inertial navigation systems.

articleTitle: Collision Detection for CoSCARA Considering Mechanical Structure and Friction Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The measurement of collision detection performance is a crucial factor in evaluating the effectiveness of collaborative robots. The accuracy of sensorless force control in collaborative robots is limited by the presence of nonlinear friction at the joints, which affects collision detection performance. This analysis focuses on the influence of friction components and mechanical structure design on friction in collaborative robots, with a specific emphasis on the nonlinear friction of the joints in these robots. The DLinear-based neural network model is utilized to simulate joint friction, enhancing the precision of friction identification. The feedforward torque is employed to compensate for the friction force, hence enhancing the sensitivity of collision detection. The experimental investigation demonstrates that utilizing a synchronous belt with a reduced transmission ratio resulted in decreased friction and increased collision detection sensitivity for the robot, hence enhancing its safety level.

articleTitle: Cooperative Motion Planning for Mobile Humanoid Robots Based on the Manipulability Map
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the integration of mobility and manipulation, mobile humanoid robot constructed by mobile platform and manipulator has become a potential solution for the industrial manufacturing and services. The strong coupling between the mobile platform and the manipulator generates a high degree of kinematic redundancy. In order to rationally allocate the motion of the mobile platform and the manipulator, a new cooperative motion planning method is proposed. The Manipulability Map (MM) that gives the distribution of the manipulability in cartesian space is first built. Then under the guidance of the MM, the mobile robot path is generated using graph search method. Meanwhile, the minimum jerk model is utilized to generate the manipulator trajectory. Moreover, a task-priority coordinated motion controller is developed to control the trajectory tracking of the mobile robot and the manipulator. In this controller, the trajectory of the manipulator is treated as the primary task and the trajectory of the mobile robot is used as the constraint task. Simulation results demonstrate that the trajectory of the mobile humanoid robot can be found and the robot can achieve high manipulability.

articleTitle: Research on Obstructed Object Detection Algorithms in Medical X-ray images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper explores the optimization of object detection algorithms for occlusions in X-ray imaging. Addressing the absence of case segmentation datasets for nursing scenarios, we compiled a substantial collection of clear and accurately labeled image datasets. After preprocessing the data, which included image scaling, linear transformation, and contrast enhancement, we conducted target detection experiments using SSD, Faster R-CNN, and optimized Faster R-CNN models. The evaluation of the models was based on the regression accuracy calculated by comparing the predicted and actual marked positions. The results indicate that while the SSD model is capable of performing occlusion area detection tasks, it is not ideal, with 11 instances of false detection and significant deviation. The traditional Faster R-CNN model showed improvement across various metrics, reducing the number of false detections to 3, yet the accuracy remained suboptimal. In contrast, the optimized Faster R-CNN model, which integrates a feature pyramid network, utilizes ResNet for feature extraction, and transforms the size, shape, position, and boundary polarity of the input data’s occlusion area, achieved stable loss values more rapidly. It demonstrated high detection accuracy with intersection rates of 74.8% and 79.0% for single-location and dual-location occlusion detection, respectively. These findings underscore the method’s feasibility and potential for practical application.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Controls in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator-Based Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Nowadays, wind energy is becoming increasingly popular among primary energy sources, and wind turbines have been in high demand in previous years. This paper studies the permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) wind turbine due to its high ratio torque to its inertia, dense power capacity, gearless design, and more efficiently at low rotation speeds with less maintenance. Extracting power from the wind turbines and injecting it into the grid is the responsibility of the power converter controller. This paper presented three types of control for PMSG-based wind turbines: field-oriented control (FOC), direct current control (DCC), and model predictive control (MPC). This research involves the dynamic behavior of wind turbine with PMSG for each control strategy under different wind speeds and prediction horizons. Detailed models of the PMSG-based wind turbine are simulated in MATLAB/ SIMULINK. The results highlighted the performance of the three types of controls against changes in wind speed.

articleTitle: Fatigue Analysis of Jumper Cables in Floating Body
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Cable fatigue is a common problem in power transmission and communication systems. The cables between floating structures are affected by harsh marine environments, resulting in frequent bending, stretching, and vibration of the cables, which seriously affects the fatigue level of the cables. Fatigue leads to a decrease in the mechanical strength of cables, increasing the risk of fracture and damage. This article proposes an innovative comprehensive fatigue assessment method to address the difficulty of accurately predicting the fatigue life of jumper cables using traditional methods. This method is based on the catenary theory and Coffin-Manson theory, combined with finite element analysis and material mechanics simulation, to more accurately predict the fatigue life of cables, The accuracy and effectiveness of the method were verified through cable simulation testing under different working conditions. The influence of changing cable parameters on cable fatigue life was observed through simulation testing. The results show that this method can improve the accuracy of prediction, provide strong evidence for cable design, reduce the maintenance and replacement costs of cables, and is of great significance for improving the reliability of offshore cable systems, providing useful references for the development and application of marine engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Meteorological Data Storage Technology Based on NetCDF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the rapid development of sensor technology and Internet technology, the amount of data collected in meteorological and scientific fields has soared. The data stored in NetCDF format is faced with the challenges of being damaged, difficult to recover, and frequent calls to disk resources. Although Hadoop distributed storage solutions have obvious advantages, HDFS based file system tools cannot be directly used for data processing due to their lack of support for the NetCDF format. Therefore, this article delves into the storage and write mechanism and block architecture of HDFS, and extends the read and write interface of NetCDF data to improve data portability, access efficiency, and sharing convenience, thereby providing strong support for scientific computing.

articleTitle: A Main Production Planning Algorithm Based on Limited Resource Capacity Pools
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A method of expressing resources as two dimensions of time and capability while tasks occupy resources proportionally is proposed to support the formulation of the main production plan under extensive management mode, focusing on the planning requirements of production capacity rather than fine operations in the master production planning. This article constructs a problem model for limited resource capacity pool constraints and production scheduling objectives, designs a gradient guided mutation NSGA-II algorithm, proposes a population initialization strategy that combines chromosome encoding, decoding, random and strategy, adopts adaptive genetic operators, and uses gradient descent method to guide mutation according to production capacity occupancy requirements, achieving the minimum planned period control of resource capacity. Finally, an example was used to verify that the system technology has good adaptability.

articleTitle: Handling Collaborative Robot System for Grasping Medical Cotton Cloth Porous with Bernoulli Gripper
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents the handling collaborative robot (Cobot) system for grasping the medical cotton cloth porous that were arranged in matching layers from one point to another point by arranged them in matching layers again. The important is to not grasping all layer objects together in once, but must be separately for each layer by layer. As the object to be grasped is the cotton cloth porous to be used in the medical purpose, thus the cleanness and must not leave any wrinkles or marks when handled the fabric are necessity required before packaging process. The proposed handling collaborative robot system contains the novel tooling called "Bernoulli Gripper" can achieve this handling task perfectly with 100% success rate of experiments. This gripper was developed to lifts the porous fabric sheet up in such a way that it does not grasping touch by utilizing four points Bernoulli principle elements like no other grippers that need to do the touching forces and always leave wrinkles or marks when handled the fabric, such as pneumatic suction cup, robot hand and fingers. Moreover, the research objective is to produce the handling robot system that can achieve the non-contact grasping and do collaborative tasks together with human in the same environment. As the result, our proposed system can be used for working together with human worker as the collaborative partner to arrange these medical cotton cloth porous products with about 6.5 seconds per sheet in the real production line suitably.

articleTitle: Human-in-the-loop: infusing knowledge into neural networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this study, we propose a method for enabling humans to initialize a neural network before training. This is a novel way of involving humans in neural network training. So far, neural networks learn very well from structured data. However, human knowledge, common sense, and experiences are not necessarily easy to express as structured data. This limits the ability of neural networks to learn from humans. This study attempts to fill the gap and enhance the learning ability of neural networks. This paper explains the structure of the neural network that supports this objective and the results of the initial experiments in transferring human knowledge to neural networks.

articleTitle: Wave Interference Suppression for Underwater Polarization Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Underwater polarization navigation has enormous potential due to the good performance of anti-interference and no accumulated error. However, during underwater navigation it was found that polarization information is highly susceptible to wave interference. In response to the issue where images collected by underwater vehicles during polarization light navigation are affected by dynamic wave disturbances. This paper proposes a method based on pseudo-color mapping and GANs for suppression of wave disturbances interference. The simulation results indicate that the denoised images exhibit significant advantages in terms of the PSNR, MSE, and SSIM indicators. Consequently, this approach significantly overcomes the interference of waves and further enhances the feasibility of biomimetic polarization navigation for underwater applications.

articleTitle: Study on the Depth Control for an "Egg-shaped" Underwater Robot Based on Backstepping Sliding Mode Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the growing demand for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) capable of precise navigation in intricate environments, achieving accurate depth control becomes pivotal. This paper introduced a pioneering study on depth control for an "Egg-shaped" underwater robot (EUR) utilizing the backstepping sliding mode control (BSMC) algorithm. By analyzing the kinematic and kinetic models of the EUR, a specialized control system was devised. This paper significantly advanced underwater robotics by presenting a robust and efficient solution for depth control, employing Lyapunov function in stability analysis. Simulation and experimental results validated the performance of the proposed algorithm in regulating the robot's depth across diverse operating conditions, surpassing traditional control methods in terms of stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Online Inductance Identification and Sensorless Control of PMSM Based on a Novel High-Frequency Square-Wave Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motors are subject to harsh and complex operating environments and have high requirements for low-speed stability. To address the problems of motor inductance distortion and the difficulty of sensorless control at low speed, this paper first analyzes the shortcomings of the conventional square-wave injection method. Then, in order to achieve d- and q-axis incremental inductance and cross-coupling inductance identification by the same injection and simultaneously realize sensorless control, a novel high-frequency voltage injection wave and the separation method of self-excited and coupled-excited currents are proposed. The verification is carried out on the simulation platform and the permanent magnet synchronous motor test bench. The results show that under acceleration and deceleration as well as current variation, inductance identification and angle tracking can be realized accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: Robotic Catheterization for Trauma-Reduced Minimally Invasive Surgeries with Morphing Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In minimally invasive surgeries, robotic technology is employed to manipulate medical instruments to reach target locations for diagnosis and treatment. It is challenging to eliminate collisions or contact between medical instruments and tissues, which increases the risk of complications for patients and limits the scope of many surgeries. This paper proposes a morph-adaptive catheter that combines magnetic deformation control with the solid-liquid phase transition capability of low-melting-point alloys. This enables the catheter to navigate around avoidance tissues and reach the target location without collisions or contact. Theoretical calculations have preliminarily verified the consistency between the expected and actual deformations, and experiments have initially demonstrated the feasibility of the proposed morph-adaptive catheter for contactless operation. This approach offers a new method to reduce tissue damage from instruments and enhance the safety of surgeries in minimally invasive surgeries.

articleTitle: Online Iterative LQR Controller for Wheeled Bipedal Robot Trajectory Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Wheeled biped balancing robot is an underactuated system with compact actuators and high energy efficiency. Balancing and rotating motions are coupled nonlinearly, posing a major challenge for accurate trajectory tracking. Although yaw motion can be implemented as a task of whole body control and realized by a pole-assignment based controller, model-predictive control (MPC) can significantly reduce trajectory tracking errors. We first derive the system dynamic of robot motion on flat ground. To take into account the dynamic nonlinearity, we deploy iterative LQR as a nonlinear MPC scheme and develop a universal real-time control framework for a nonlinear time-varying system. The proposed system architecture is deployed on a wheeled biped robot platform and tested to track time-dependent B-spine trajectory. Experimental results of physical experiments shows that our online iterative LQR feedback scheme outperforms the baseline controller and shows robustness to disturbances.

articleTitle: Improved DRAEM: Enhance the Unsupervised AD in Defect Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Surface defect detection is a critical aspect of the manufacturing process, requiring accurate detection methods to ensure product quality. Traditional fully-supervised detection methods require extensive annotated data, leading to significant labeling costs. This study introduces a novel self-supervised surface defect detection method using synthetic pseudo defect samples, achieving pixel-level detection with only normal samples for training. Adopting a structure similar to DRAEM, this method concatenates the generative and discriminative networks, using both the input and output of the generative model to enhance the discriminative network's decision boundaries. Introducing a multi-head attention mechanism and a Group Aggregation Bridge (GAB) module for feature fusion significantly boosts the discriminative network's performance and segmentation accuracy. Extensive comparative experiments with a variety of similar anomaly detection algorithms have demonstrated the superior segmentation performance of this work.

articleTitle: An optimal AGV fleet sizing estimation method for flexible manufacturing systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To solve the automated guided vehicle (AGV) fleet sizing problem under the coupling characteristics of processing and transportation in flexible manufacturing systems (FMS), an optimal AGV fleet sizing estimation method is proposed. First, this paper studies the coupling characteristics of processing and transportation without buffer zones, and conducts a detailed analysis of the specific steps and resource flows in the production process. Then, a semi-open queuing network (SOQN) model is established to analyze the effect of the number and utilization of AGV and workstation resources on production efficiency. Finally, fully consider production efficiency and cost, and establish an optimal AGV fleet sizing estimation model. A simulation model is built using FlexSim to validate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Study on a Novel Fuzzy PID Control System for the Ellipsoidal Underwater Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) have gained popularity for their exceptional maneuverability and versatility in marine environments. However, conventional PID methods often fail to achieve precise control in complex environments, as they lack accuracy in nonlinear systems. This paper developed a fuzzy PID control system for the Ellipsoidal Underwater Robot (EUR) to improve its stability and precision. Firstly, the structure and motion characteristics of the EUR were introduced. Then, the principles of the fuzzy PID control were analyzed and implemented to the EUR. Through simulations and underwater experiments, the effectiveness of the control system was evaluated and the results highlighted the significant improvement in motion stability and control accuracy achieved by the fuzzy PID control algorithm. This paper provided valuable insights and methodologies for the development of control systems in underwater robots.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of 2-MMPPHR Based on Micro-Perforated Panels and Helmholtz Resonators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In recent years, the issue of low-frequency broadband sound absorption in noise control has attracted considerable attention in the field of research and engineering. In this paper, an innovative acoustic metamaterial structure, the second-order multi-layer Micro-perforated panel absorbers backed by Helmholtz resonators (2-MMPPHR), comprising multiple microperforated panel integrated with a Helmholtz resonator is proposed. Utilizing the local resonance principle of Helmholtz resonators and the characteristics of microperforated panel, we successfully achieve broadband sound absorption across low and medium to high frequency ranges. Through sensitivity analysis of structural parameters, we identify significant effects of Helmholtz resonator parameters on both the absorption coefficient and bandwidth. Lastly, employing genetic algorithm optimization, we attain a 2-MMPPHR configuration with 80% sound absorption within the region of 296-1000 Hz.

articleTitle: A Study of Lightweight, Low-cost Quadrupedal Robot Body Based on a Coaxial Deformation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, we present a lightweight, versatile, and low-cost quadrupedal robot ontology with two rapidly interchangeable leg types and two modes of wheels and legs. First, we developed a lightweight, low-cost quadrupedal robot ontology, and then, based on Lywal and Taichi developed by our predecessors, we modified their ontologies into interchangeable structures so that the coaxial morphing robot realizes the functions of two robots. In addition, we conducted wheel-footed and obstacle-crossing experiments to fully verify their functionality and stability. Finally, other developers can conduct exploratory research in related fields based on this robot ontology, which can shorten its research cycle and reduce the development cost.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Jumper Cables for Offshore Floating Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic mechanical properties of jumper cables in offshore floating photovoltaic power systems are studied. By establishing a mathematical model based on parabola theory and using finite element simulation software for experimental analysis, the stability and reliability of jumper cable in Marine environment are discussed in this study. It is found that the design and laying of jumper cables are crucial to the performance of the entire power system, especially in the electrical properties, mechanical properties, weather resistance and corrosion resistance of the cables. In addition, factors such as the bending radius, tension, redundant length and protective measures of the cable also need to be carefully considered to ensure the normal operation and maintenance of the cable, reduce costs and extend the life of the cable. This study provides theoretical support for the scale, commercialization and standardization of offshore photovoltaic power systems, and has guiding significance for future design and performance optimization.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Self-reconfigurable Modular Wheel-legged Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper designed a self-reconfigurable modular wheel-legged robot. The four-bar wheel-leg structure endows it with two modes of motion: wheeled movement and jumping; an active docking mechanism enables it to autonomously select and dock with robot modules based on the movement environment and task requirements, achieving both excellent terrain adaptability and intelligence. A kinematic model for the four-bar wheel-leg structure and the active docking end was established. The motion modes of the robot and the feasibility of the active docking mechanism were simulated and assessed using ROS2-Gazebo, laying a foundation for future research on motion control and docking control of self-reconfigurable modular wheel-legged robots.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Breast Ultrasound Scanning Based on Three-Dimensional Point Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The incidence rate of breast cancer is increasing year by year in the world. Traditional breast ultrasound scanning methods are increasingly unable to meet people's medical needs. To improve the efficiency and accuracy of breast ultrasound scanning, a method of breast ultrasound scanning path planning based on three-dimensional (3D) point cloud model is proposed. A method of 3D breast point cloud reconstruction based on kinect camera is adopted. Kinect camera was calibrated and breast images were collected. 3D breast point cloud model was established based on spatial point. A method of extracting path points in ultrasound scanning based on the minimum two-dimensional fitting plane is proposed, and the extracted path points are fitted by cubic B-spline curve. The experimental platform was built and the hand-to-eye calibration experiment was conducted. Through the path error experiment of ultrasound scanning, it is verified that the average error between the planned path and the actual path in x, y, and z direction is 0.66 mm, 0.68 mm and 0.82 mm.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Robot Localization Algorithm with Improved ORB Extraction Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inaccurate positioning accuracy of V-SLAM system caused by poor texture and blurred images generated by mobile robots during rapid movement and large angle rotation, an improved ORB feature extraction matching algorithm is proposed. Firstly, using the statistical form of information entropy to calculate the image features, image enhancement is used to highlight the feature information of poorly textured and blurred image blocks, improve the efficiency of feature point detection, and enhance the robustness of the system. In addition, to improve the accuracy of feature matching, the BEBLID descriptor is used instead of the BRIEF descriptor for feature description. Through experimental verification on the publicly available TUM data set, it was found that the improved algorithm has a higher matching accuracy than the ORB algorithm, and has a significant increase in algorithm time compared to the ORB algorithm. After trajectory calculation, the improved algorithm is more in line with the real trajectory in camera motion and has a good improvement in pose accuracy.

articleTitle: Improved Image Segmentation Algorithms based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Image segmentation techniques based on Full Convolutional Neural Networks (FCNs) have the capability to directly process images of arbitrary sizes. This eliminates the need for complex intermediate steps and achieves end-to-end pixel-level segmentation, thereby enhancing segmentation accuracy. This paper, after an in-depth study of image segmentation techniques and convolutional neural networks, integrates the FCN technique with image segmentation technology. It constructs an FCN network based on the ResNet network, accomplishing pixel-level segmentation of images. To overcome the limitations of the original FCN network, specifically its mediocre performance on deep neural networks and excessive downsampling rates, certain improvements have been implemented. Dilated convolutions are employed to expand the receptive field during convolution, facilitating the learning of more intricate features.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Trajectory Tracking Control for Inspection Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In addressing the issue of minimizing angle and distance deviation during trajectory tracking of inspection mobile robots, this paper proposes a trajectory tracking rapid response control algorithm based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC). Initially, by deriving the relationship between robot trajectory deviation and wheel speed, the kinematic model of the mobile robot is established. Subsequently, the dynamic model of the mobile robot is constructed. An extended state observer is employed to estimate unmodeled components of the system and external disturbances. The LADRC method is utilized to eliminate them. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through simulation experiments and real-world testing. Results demonstrate that the proposed trajectory tracking control method effectively reduces errors during the trajectory tracking process, leading to system stability.

articleTitle: An Optimized Model Predictive Flux Linkage Control without Weight Coefficient for Vehicle Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to eliminate the weight coefficient in the traditional model predictive torque control (MPTC) of three-phase asynchronous motor, an model predictive flux linkage control (UCMPFC) with improved value function is used by analyzing the relationship between torque and flux linkage of asynchronous motor, and the weight coefficient is eliminated. Based on UCMPFC and deadbeat control, obtain a brand-new expected voltage vector. By judging the position of the expected voltage vector, a new model predictive flux linkage control (UCMPFC2) is obtained, which decreases the quantity of traversal times, decreases the quantity of voltage vectors to be selected from 8 to 2, and decreases the calculation amount. In addition, the weak magnetic control and model predictive control algorithm are combined to broaden the speed range of the asynchronous motor for vehicle. In order to obtain as much electromagnetic torque as possible and prevent oversize three- phase current, the torque reference value is redesigned. The simulation results display that the used method has great control performance

articleTitle: Optimization study of ultrasonic vibration extrusion process parameters for 304 stainless steel shaft parts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to explore the optimal parameter range for the surface machining of ultrasonic vibratory extrusion shaft artifacts, a surface property prediction model and a multi-objective optimization method based on ultrasonic vibratory extrusion machining are proposed. Experiments using ultrasonic vibratory extrusion machining were carried out on 304 stainless steel material, and a surface property prediction model was established based on the response face test results, and the objective function was optimized using the NSGA II multi-objective genetic algorithm. The optimization results show that the specimen surface hardness, surface roughness and residual stress can also be effectively controlled in the appropriate processing parameter domain.NSGA II algorithm can improve the processing quality, productivity and processing efficiency of ultrasonic vibration extrusion machining, which helps to promote the application and development of ultrasonic vibration extrusion machining technology in industrial production.

articleTitle: A Modular Robotic System for Tibial Fracture Reduction and Rehabilitation with Vibrational Stimuli Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper introduces a modular robotic system aimed at tibial fracture reduction and rehabilitation with vibrational stimuli generation. With the development of the economy and the diversification of entertainment, the incidence of traumatic orthopedics is increasing, especially tibial shaft fractures rank first among lower limb fracture types. Compared to traditional manual techniques by physicians, robot-assisted reduction surgery offers higher precision and reduces the risk of physician exposure to X-ray radiation. Studies have shown that mechanical stimuli help promote trabecular bone growth, resulting in stronger postoperative calluses. However, vibration has not yet been applied to fracture rehabilitation in reduction medical devices. Therefore, this article innovatively designs a modular robotic system capable of both reduction operations and vibrational stimulation, aiming to achieve the integration of reduction and rehabilitation of tibial fractures.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of License Plate Positioning Algorithm based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Compared to image processing platforms such as CPU and GPU, FPGA have advantages in terms of real-time performance. The license plate positioning method based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) proposed in this paper only takes 13ms to process a frame of 640*480 images, which takes 19ms based on GPU and 58ms based on CPU[1]. The image preprocessing method of binarization by single-channel color requires a high degree of chromaticity of the license plate part in the image. Especially when the color of the license plate is similar to the car body color, the recognition accuracy is very low. The method of binarization using two-channel mask proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of license plate recognition when the color of the license plate is similar to that of the car body or the chroma of the license plate is insufficient. Because in the actual installation of the license plate, there are four rivets on the upper and lower edges. So in the image after Sobel edge detection, the rivets affect the completeness of the upper and lower edges, resulting in irregular lines on the upper and lower edges of the license plate. When using the traditional pole method to locate the upper and lower boundaries, the error is more than 12%. When using the three-order matrix method proposed in this paper to locate the boundaries of the license plate, the error value of the four boundaries is no more than 5%, compared with the manually calibrated coordinates.

articleTitle: Development of the Physical Simulation Platform for Catenary Cantilever
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Regarding to the problem of deviations in the cantilever pre-assembling, a physical simulation platform for cantilevers has been developed. This platform simulates the actual operating conditions of the high-speed rail pantograph-catenary and conducts simulated inspections and calculations to the pre-assembling cantilever before installation, obtaining stagger value data and predicting whether the cantilever is qualified or not. This allows for timely adjustments or re-manufacturing of the cantilever, thereby effectively reducing construction risks.

articleTitle: Research on Attitude Control of Cable Underwater Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper studies the attitude control system of a cabled underwater cleaning robot. Aiming at the problem that the underwater cleaning robot with cable is affected by unknown disturbances such as ocean waves and umbilical cables during operation, and the attitude stability control is difficult, a multi-thruster hybrid thrust allocation strategy combining pseudo-inverse method and effective set iterative algorithm is proposed. The underwater cleaning robot 's backstepping sliding mode attitude control strategy is designed. In order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the attitude control method, Simulink is used for numerical example simulation analysis. Finally, the robot attitude control pool experiment is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the inverse sliding mode attitude controller applied to the cabled underwater cleaning robot.

articleTitle: Relative Motion Recovery Reconstruction Algorithm for Fixed Cameras
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the structure from motion algorithm needs to change the position of the camera in the process of camera shooting, we utilize the relationship between the relative motion of the object and the camera to obtain the image sequence containing the multi-angle view of the object. A relative structure from motion is designed and realized by locating the region where the object is located in the image sequence and constraining the applicable range of feature point extraction. The experimental results show that the SFRM algorithm is applicable to the fixed position of the camera, and can increase the proportion of matched pairs located in the object region from 32% to 84% of the total number of matched pairs, and improve the time efficiency by 38.29% compared with the traditional SFM algorithm, thus successfully expanding the applicability of the SFM algorithm.

articleTitle: Dynamic Friction Model with Velocity and Asymmetric Load Dependency for Robot Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In robot control, accurate modeling of joint friction behavior contributes to enhancing friction compensation, which is important for robust torque control of robots. In this paper, a nonlinear friction model of robot joints is proposed that takes into account the effects of velocity and asymmetric load torque. For the friction induced by velocity, a cubic polynomial is employed to describe the viscous friction across the entire velocity range, while introducing two parameters to characterize the Coulomb friction and Stribeck effect. For the load torque, a four-quadrant is utilized to describe the asymmetry of friction. Furthermore, the proposed static friction model is integrated the standard Generalized Maxwell slip (GMS) model, thereby getting an improved dynamic friction model. Finally, the comparative experiments are implemented on a robot joint, the results indicate that the model proposed in this paper achieves higher accuracy.

articleTitle: A Method for Rapid Generation of Passive Dynamic Walking Gait Based on Gait Library
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Passive dynamic walking offers an effective way achieving energy-efficient bipedal locomotion. In this paper, we present a method for rapidly generating gaits based on a gait library. Initially, a set of period-1 passive dynamic walking gaits is pre-computed. Then, these gaits are parameterized using Bezier curves. Finally, by employing polynomial regression to fit gait features and parameters, a gait library is constructed. Case studies are conducted on a compass-like biped model and a kneed biped model. The results demonstrate that the gait library is capable of rapidly generating a desired gait within 1 millisecond, with energy consumption almost equivalent to that of passive dynamic walking.

articleTitle: Mouse Pose Estimation Using Synthetic Datasets Replicating Experimental Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Quantitative measurement of animal behavior using machine learning techniques has gained significant attention, and stable animal pose estimation is crucial for this purpose. While various methodologies for pose estimation using deep learning have been proposed in ideal experimental settings, few have addressed challenges in real-world environments with high occlusion. In this study, we aimed to achieve stable animal pose estimation under these conditions. Synthetic data generation has emerged as a viable solution that offers a cost-effective approach compared with real data annotation. Our approach involves creating synthetic datasets tailored to specific experimental scenarios, such as the foot fault test. We developed 3D models of mice and experimental setups, which enabled us to render synthetic datasets with diverse environmental factors. We evaluated the effectiveness of pose estimation using these synthetic datasets, achieving promising results that demonstrate the potential for real-world applications in animal behavior research. Further advancements include 2D and 3D pose estimation techniques validated through comprehensive testing and evaluation.

articleTitle: An improved YOLOv5 algorithm for enhancing pre-classification of soft gripper grasp
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: As a popular direction in the field of robotics, soft robots have many applications, for example, rescue, medical treatment, and human-computer interaction because of their flexibility and high adaptability. As a representative of soft robots, the soft hand is most used in object grasping. Therefore, it is necessary to explore and study soft hand-grasping technology. Object detection technology based on deep learning brings a new opportunity to the development of soft hand. It can pre-classify objects to be grasped in a non-contact way, so that a soft hand can better determine the grasping posture. Based on the YOLOv5 algorithm, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm to enhance the pre-classification ability of soft hands. A SamAM attention module has been introduced into the YOLOv5 structure to weigh different hierarchical features, making it more suitable for grasping situations. The experimental results show that on VOC2007, COCO, and common food data sets, the improved algorithm has different degrees of improvement in the evaluation performance index.

articleTitle: Flexible Calibration for Digital Fringe Projection Profilometry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: System calibration is essential for digital fringe projection 3D shape measurement. There are many calibration researches focusing on phase-to-height conversion, while the transverse calibration accuracy is less discussed, which is also very important. In this paper, we do reconstruction from object phase map to 3D coordinates through simple and global calibration and show improvements in transverse (X-Y coordinates) calibration, with camera lens distortion considered. algorithm only requires a 2D calibration board to be placed at several random positions. Projector calibration as an inverse camera is not needed. Since no specific parameters of the projector is needed to be calculated, our algorithm is flexible and easy to be applied on arbitrarily arranged digital fringe projection systems including those with a defocused projector.

articleTitle: An Improved Time Delay Estimation Algorithm in Microphone Array Sound Source Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to enhance the precision of sound source localization in microphone arrays operating within low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) environments, an improved time delay estimation algorithm is proposed based on the generalized cross-correlation (GCC) algorithm. The algorithm suppresses noise interference on the signal, and increases the relative values of the main and side peaks of the cross-correlation function, thereby modifying the accuracy of time delay estimation. A simulation experiment involving time delay estimation and sound source localization based on a six-element cross-microphone array is conducted in MATLAB. A comparative analysis of the time delay estimation performance between the proposed algorithm, the GCC algorithm, and the quadratic correlation algorithm is conducted. Furthermore, the sound source localization effect of the improved algorithm is simulated under low SNR conditions. The simulation results reveal that the proposed modified algorithm, compared to the GCC and quadratic correlation algorithms, sharpens the peak of the cross-correlation function, significantly enhances the accuracy of time delay estimation, and exhibits robust noise resistance and smaller sound source localization errors in low SNR environments.

articleTitle: FATUnetr:fully attention Transformer for 3D medical image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Recent studies have explored the applicability of the Transformer model in 3D medical segmentation tasks. The core attention mechanism of transformer, has the property of capturing remote dependencies, which is highly robust when segmenting medical images. Inspired by the emerging visual groupings in Vision Transformers (ViTs), self-attention can be made more robust by improving the intermediate representation. We propose a novel framework called FATUnetr that aims to take advantage of the full attention module to improve accuracy. We also reduce the number of parameters by applying deeply separable convolution at the bottleneck layer. We have verified the effectiveness in the extracranial vault multiple atlas labelling (BTCV) dataset for multi-organ segmentation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of Self-Eliminating-Backlash 3K Planetary Gear Train with Flexure-based Carrier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: 3K Planetary Gear Train (PGT) is a promising gear reducer for collaborative robots and humanoid robots due to its high reduction ratio and high bidirectional efficiencies. To improve the accuracy of the 3K PGT further, a Self-Eliminating-Backlash 3K (SEB-3K) PGT is proposed, which eliminates the backlash automatically through the designed flexure-based carrier. However, the effects of the designed carrier on the 3K PGT need to be further analyzed. As such, the lumped parameter dynamic model considering the preload of the carrier is established for the SEB-3K PGT. Based on the dynamic model, the output velocity fluctuation and the lost motion of the SEB3K PGT versus the preload of the carrier are simulated. From the results, the working states of the SEB-3K PGT are divided into five zones by the preload of the carrier and the reason is analyzed, which provides a reference for the parameter design of the flexure-based carrier.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Method of GFM Converter Combined with Improved LADRC Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy generation in the power system, the inertia of the system becomes smaller than before and the frequency stability is weakened. Due to the deepening development of control technology, grid-forming (GFM) is increasingly being used. In order to solve the problem of frequency change caused by uncertain disturbance in microgrid, an improved linear active disturbance rejection control strategy is proposed. In this method, GFM control based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is used to improve the inertia level of the system, and then part of the obtained model information is combined with the linear extended state observer to improve the observation speed of the observer. Finally, a simulation model is established in Matlab/Simulink, and the effectiveness of the improved strategy in improving the immunity and frequency stability of the inverter is analyzed and verified.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Structural Reliable Position-Mooring of FPSO based on Nonlinear Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper proposes a structural reliability-based position mooring control scheme subject to unknown environment disturbance, system uncertainties and control input constraints. Structural reliability of mooring cables is proposed as a breaking strength evaluating index to derive the mathematical model of position mooring system. A nonlinear extended state observer is constructed to estimate position, velocity and total system uncertainties, it is independent of an accurate system model and prior knowledge. Considering the constraints of structural reliability, control input and control increment, a structural reliability-based nonlinear model predictive controller is proposed to solve control input saturation. It is proved that the proposed controller can maintain the structural reliability and heading at the desired value. It is able to fully use the mooring system for positioning while keeping the cable safe, so that the vessel can realize the safe and energy-efficient area keeping. Comparative simulations are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed position mooring control scheme.

articleTitle: Neural Network Fault Diagnosis for Open Circuit Fault of Synchronous Generator Rectifier Element
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Polyphase rectifier synchronous generator has been widely used in marine power system and marine electric propulsion because of its excellent power supply reliability and power quality. It is of practical significance to study its fault diagnosis technology. This paper takes the open-circuit fault of rectifier components of polyphase rectifier synchronous generator as an example. According to the fault mechanism, a fault diagnosis model is designed by combining the results of fault feature wavelet packet decomposition with SOM neural network, and compared with PNN neural network. The extracted fault features are subdivided by wavelet packet decomposition, and the detail spectrum features of the subdivided fault features are used in fault diagnosis and fault feature extraction based on intelligent algorithm, which improves the reliability and accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Nighttime Vehicle Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Nighttime vehicle detection is crucial for improving road traffic safety and driving experience. However, traditional detection systems face challenges in low-light conditions and are affected by vehicle lights, resulting in low detection accuracy. A night vehicle detection model based on YOLOv8 is proposed in this paper to solve this problem. We combine C2f module with an attention mechanism and introduce the upsampling operator CARAFE to enhance the fusion and exchange of feature information, thus improving the accuracy of nighttime vehicle detection. Additionally, the original regression loss function CIoU is improved to capture the shape characteristics of the bounding box more flexibly and enable the model to have stronger robustness and faster convergence speed. Experiments on nighttime traffic data sets demonstrate that the enhanced method retains real-time performance while significantly improving nighttime vehicle detection accuracy compared to the original YOLOv8 model.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level Feature Fusion Framework for Spoken Language Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Spoken language understanding(SLU) constitutes an essential component of task-based dialogue, primarily focusing on intent detection(ID) and slot filling(SF). Generally, researchers treat these two tasks as sentence classification and sequence labeling tasks. Although significant success has been achieved in this area, it seems that the overall accuracy has reached a bottleneck. Through empirical research, we demonstrate that many researchers neglect the information interaction between the two tasks when modeling them jointly, or that most of the carefully designed components do not achieve the expected effect. Based on this, we propose a multi-level feature fusion method for spoken language understanding, which consists of two basic components - the multi-level feature intent feature fusion module and the intentslot bridging unit. The multi-level feature intent module can integrate each token-level corpus information into the intent feature, while the intent-slot bridging unit can combine the sentence-level intent feature with the slot feature vector. With novel and simple design, these two modules can effectively fuse features. We conducted experiments on two classic datasets in the SLU field, and the experiments prove that our proposed method can greatly improve the overall accuracy and achieve state-of-the-art on various metrics.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Underwater Robot Inspired by Sea Turtles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, we design and build a bionic robot based on a sea turtle. The part of the device includes joint design, sealing design and controls. The sinusoidal curve is used to analyze the turtle robot's fin motion profile and to control the way it moves. Individual joints are given movement curves during sea turtle movement. Synergy of different fin joints during sea turtle movement is verified with MATLAB software. In addition, we also measure the propulsion force of the bionic turtle robot. The experimental results show that the use of trigonometric curves for the fin joint trajectory of the turtle robot can lead to an appropriate motion.

articleTitle: Compliant control system of intelligent walking aid based on multi-sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A multi-sensor-based intelligent walker compliant control system and its hardware control scheme are proposed to address the unnatural and unsmooth control problems of common wheeled walkers. The system adopts a brushless motor as the power source, acquires upper limb pressure data through the pressure sensor at the handrail, and processes the data using a filtering algorithm to determine the upper limb movement intention. At the same time, inertial sensors are used to detect the acceleration information of the lower limbs, and laser sensors are used to measure the distance between the user and the walker to realize the perception of the lower limb movement intention. By sensing the upper and lower limb movement intentions, the walker and the user achieve a high degree of human-machine integration, which results in smoother and more natural walker control. In addition, the speed of the walker is controlled through the fusion of multi-sensor data to ensure the safety of the user. This intelligent walker compliant control system provides an effective solution for the control performance of wheeled walkers and has potential application prospects.

articleTitle: Tableware Recognition for Tidying-up Robot System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: We determined the need to install an automatic tidying-up robot at the cafeteria's tableware return counter to save labor force, and we investigated tableware classification under complex conditions, which included seven types of tableware, leftovers, and garbage. We proposed a height-matching algorithm as a method to improve recognition accuracy in RGB-D image recognition. Two recognition methods were introduced: one based on contour recognition and the other based on the YOLOv7 algorithm, which was enhanced with height-matching. We validated the recognition capabilities of these two algorithms in complex scenarios. The contour recognition accuracy was 58.2%, whereas the height-matching-based YOLOv7 algorithm achieved 93.0%. Despite having significantly lower contour recognition accuracy than YOLOv7, it showed promising research potential in combating interference.

articleTitle: An Actuator Based on Linkage Structure and Control System Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A robot system based on a linkage structure, which can precisely perceive the working state by utilizing a variety of sensors carried on board. A multi-sensor data fusion strategy to integrate more accurate data based on different working states of the robot, thereby enhancing the robot’s capabilities in receiving commands and perceiving the environment. Furthermore, at the control level, a neural network control based on radial basis functions is applied to the robot. This algorithm leverages the approximation properties of neural networks to estimate disturbances and uncertainties in the nonlinear system of the robot more accurately, enabling smoother and faster control. Experimental validation demonstrates that the utilization of neural network control on this robot yields superior control performance compared to traditional PID control, affirming its high operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Multi-degree-of-freedom Simulation Platform for Actual Shield Machine Tool Changing Posture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the development of society, the shield tunneling method has gained wide application due to its numerous advantages. Shield machine, as the most important equipment for shield tunneling method construction, requires frequent tool change operations during the construction process. Currently, the tool change operations are mainly implemented manually, resulting in low efficiency, high risk, and high cost. Therefore, there is an increasingly strong demand for the application of robot tool change, and research has been conducted at home and abroad. However,due to the complexity of the underground environment and the high cost of shield tunneling machines themselves, the tool changing robot needs to spend a lot of time on simulation and verification before it can be used in actual operations. In order to enable the tool changing robot to truly simulate and verify the underground tool changing process, this article designs a multi-degree-of-freedom tool attitude simulation platform based on the parameters of mainstream shield tunneling machines. Servo motors are used for driving, and the positioning requirements are ensured through reducer, high-precision rotation platform and screw rod connection. At the same time, through load calculation, the selection of the main components is confirmed. Finally, through the use of physical objects combined with the tool changing robot, it is also proved that the design meets the requirements, providing great convenience for the verification and simulation of the tool changing robot.

articleTitle: Mechanical Design of Out-pipe Detection Mechanisms for Pipeline Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Pipes in various are dominated in in the process of industrial production. To avoid the pipeline leak due to inner corrosion, it is essential to develop pipe inspection mechanisms to detect the wall thickness of the pipes used in production. The paper presents three kinds of out-pipe detection mechanisms (ODM) for different petrochemical pipeline detection demands based on eddy current testing (ECT) method. A linear inspection mechanism with fixed length is firstly proposed to detect defects of straight pipe. Secondly, a rotary inspection mechanism is designed for pipeline weld detection. Besides, an out-pipe scanning wheeled robotic mechanism is developed to detect wall thickness of pipes and avoid small obstacles such as valves on the pipelines. Lastly, detection experiments and simulations are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the designed out-pipe detection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Multi-Mode PID Aircraft Anti-Skid Braking Control System Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The aircraft anti-skid braking system is crucial for the safety and smoothness of aircraft landing and is a key research area in aircraft design. With the development of modern aircraft, the requirements for braking performance are becoming increasingly demanding. The traditional PID-type aircraft anti-skid brake system has problems such as low-speed skidding, poor robustness, and weak adaptability, gradually failing to meet the development requirements of aircraft braking. To address the problems of traditional PID control systems, this paper proposes a multi-mode PID aircraft anti-skid braking control strategy based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). It adopts real-time optimization of PID controller parameters using PSO and formulates braking strategies for high, low, and very low-speed segments based on aircraft speed. A complete simulation model of the aircraft anti-skid brake system and control strategy was established using the Matlab/AMESim platform, with optimal slip ratio as the control objective for simulation verification. The results show that the proposed control strategy can effectively solve the problem of poor low-speed control performance of the traditional strategy, and significantly improve the aircraft anti-skid brake performance.

articleTitle: Kinematic analysis and trajectory planning of two-limb 4-DOF high-speed parallel robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Focusing on the pick-and-place operation in the electronic, packaging, and other light industries, this paper proposed a new type 3T1R (T-Translation, R-Rotation) high-speed parallel robot with two limbs. Compared with other 4-DOF high-speed parallel robots with four limbs, its structure is simpler while the working space is larger, such that the potential for cheaper usage in the industry is achieved. The robot's kinematic analysis and trajectory planning, including key aspects, are also outlined here. Firstly, the robot's closed-loop constraint equation is established using the vector chain method. The displacement, velocity, and acceleration models are derived, and the Jacobian matrix is obtained. On this basis, the gate shape trajectory is planned using the 3-4-5 polynomial motion rule, such that the displacement, velocity, and acceleration of the driving joint are obtained using the kinematic models above. Ultimately, the accuracy of the kinematic models is confirmed by comparing the theoretical outcomes with the simulations carried out in SolidWorks. The study presented in this paper establishes a firm basis for the dimensional integration and the creation of a physical model of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on Activity Scheduling of Flexible Manufacturing Cell Based on PDDL
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: When the traditional mathematical modeling method is used for Flexible Manufacturing Cell (FMC) activity scheduling, it has the limitation that it can only schedule the simple activity of a single object. This paper selects a specific FMC layout as the research object and first analyzes the activity sequence flow of single workpiece processing. Then, taking 2 workpieces of J1 and J2 as research cases, the problem of FMC activity scheduling is described as a PDDL model based on predicate, function, object, and activity by using PDDL, and the PDDL model is solved by using LGP-TD, and the scheduling scheme that is in line with the actual production activity sequence is obtained. Finally, this paper solves PDDL models for problems of different scales, and obtains reasonable scheduling schemes, thus verifying the feasibility of using PDDL to solve FMC activity scheduling problems, breaks through the limitation that the traditional mathematical modeling method can only schedule the simple activities of a single object, and provides a useful reference for the research of FMC control system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Parameters Identification for 6-DoF Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The 6-degree-of-freedom (DoF) industrial robot has been widely used in industrial production. Accurate dynamics model is essential for achieving accurate torque control, and dynamic parameters identification is fundamental for establishing a precise dynamics model. Furthermore, the influence of joint friction on joint torque is not negligible. Thus, in this paper, a linearized dynamics model including joint friction is established. Then, in order to sufficiently stimulate the dynamic characteristics, the excitation trajectory of each joint is designed by optimization criterion. The actual torque and motion data of each joint are collected from controller, and the parameters are identified by least square (LS) estimation method. The identified dynamic parameters in this paper are applied to construct a linearized dynamics model, and root mean square error (RMSE) values of two verification trajectories between the estimated joint torques of the dynamics model and the measured joint torques are less than the allowed values.

articleTitle: Performance Study of High-speed Switching Valve Bridge Pilot Hydraulic System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To solve the problem, most existing electro-hydraulic proportional valves still have a large throttling loss, poor stability, and low control accuracy. Aiming at the limitations of the existing electro-hydraulic proportional valves, this paper combines the advantages of simple structure, small throttling loss, high energy efficiency, high stability, and high tolerance of oil contamination of the high-speed switching valve to build a pilot stage hydraulic system with the high-speed switching valve as the core component. Derivation of mathematical models for high-speed switching valves and pilot stages. The control performance of the whole pilot hydraulic system is studied through theoretical derivation analysis and simulation research verification. It is found that, with the increase of the control frequency of the pilot stage, the steady-state error of the main spool is reduced from 0.01654mm to 0.01432mm, the steady-state error is reduced by 13.4%, and the control accuracy of the main valve is improved; with the increase of the oil supply pressure of the pilot stage, the rise time of the main spool is reduced from 0.1412s to 0.0958s, and the rise time is reduced by 32.15%.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Collection of Offshore Floating Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, for the cable pooling problem of offshore floating photovoltaic system, a path planning study of offshore floating body spanning cable based on improved A-star algorithm is proposed. Cables for power transmission between floats, enabling the networking of photovoltaic systems between multiple floats, thereby increasing the power generation efficiency of the entire system. When spanning cables between floats at sea, it is important to consider not only the material, durability, and economy of the cables, but also the way they are spanned. Under the premise of meeting the normal power generation of the photovoltaic power generation system, this paper is based on the A-star algorithm, which completes the simultaneous planning of multiple paths. This paper finally achieves the features of shortest cable crossing path, economy and simplicity of construction, operation, and maintenance.

articleTitle: A New Rotor Structure of Permanent Magnet Flat Wire Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A permanent magnet (PM) flat wire motor holds great potential for advancement in the electric vehicle industry due to its elevated power density and efficiency. The reluctance of a mainstream double "V" type rotor of the PM flat wire motor is large, which leads to low utilization of permanent magnets and high cost of the motor. This article proposes a new rotor structure that can enhance the torque density of the motor and optimize the utilization of PM. Firstly, the magnetic circuit characteristics of new rotor and double "V" type rotor are compared, and the principle of performance superiority of the new rotor is expounded. Secondly, the simulation model for the electromagnetic field of the flat wire motor has been established, and the impact of new rotor on the motor's performance is being compared and analyzed. The findings indicate that the new rotor offers advantages in increasing torque density and reducing the cost of the motor.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Analysis of a Novel Dual-Drug Delivery Capsule Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In the management of digestive system and gastrointestinal tract diseases, oral administration is frequently utilized, depending on the interaction between the drug's coating and the digestive tract's chemical properties for targeted delivery. Nonetheless, the intricacy of the human digestive system and the variability in digestive states among individuals, or even within the same individual at different times, can adversely affect drug efficacy. To overcome these challenges, this study introduces a novel dual-drug delivery capsule robot featuring an internal cam mechanism and dual medication chambers, capable of precise drug release in specific gastrointestinal locations, followed by natural expulsion. This advanced delivery method reduces bodily irritation and enhances drug effectiveness. The capsule robot's design facilitates the transport and release of either identical or two distinct drugs at one or multiple targeted sites, significantly improving the versatility and efficiency of drug delivery within the gastrointestinal tract.

articleTitle: Model-free Adaptive Heading Control of Hovercraft Based on Data-driven
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper addresses the heading control challenge of hovercraft, considering their unique navigational characteristics such as a minimal underwater physical field, limited resistance to wind and waves, and unstable regions. To tackle these issues, an enhanced data-driven control approach has been utilized to investigate the heading control issue in hovercrafts. Initially, the dynamic uncertainty model of the hovercraft is linearized into an equivalent data model using pseudo-partial derivatives. Subsequently, a model-free self-adaptive PD control algorithm for hovercraft heading is developed in conjunction with the PD feedback control law. Additionally, an incremental PID controller is designed to regulate the hovercraft's speed to manage the numerous unstable areas. The efficacy of the proposed data-driven heading control algorithm is substantiated through simulation tests. A distinctive aspect of this research is the development of a hovercraft heading and speed control method that operates without relying on any model information, suitable for control systems that are highly nonlinear and strongly coupled, where establishing an accurate model is challenging. Notably, the control system design is based solely on the input and output data such as the hovercraft's pitch, rudder angle, speed, and heading.

articleTitle: Rubbing Oracle Bone Character Recognition Based on Improved YOLOv8 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition accuracy caused by the background noise of oracle bone characters and irregular font morphology, as well as the deployment requirements of application scenarios such as research and education, exhibitions, etc., the paper proposes a lightweight improved YOLOv8n oracle bone character recognition algorithm. First, the incorporation of the Deformable Convolutional Networks Version 2 module in the backbone network aims to improve the model's ability to extract irregular target features. Second, the redundant small target detection layer is removed to reduce the model complexity to decrease the computation. Finally, a lightweight CA attention mechanism is added in front of the detection head to effectively capture the relationship between channel and position and improve the feature representation ability of the model. The experimental results show that the improved model improves the accuracy by 2.9%, reduces the computation by 30%, and the number of parameters is only 3.2M to meet the deployment requirements of the application scenarios.

articleTitle: Kinematic modeling and simulation of a 5-DOF hybrid mechanism for active vibration isolation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Vibration generated by road bumps can cause secondary injury to patients. The risk of secondary injury can be significantly reduced by attaching an active suspension system to isolation medical beds. In this paper, a five DOFs (degree of freedoms) hybrid mechanism is designed by combining a 3-P(UU)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> mechanism and a 2-PUS mechanism through a universal joint, leading to 3T2R movement capabilities to reduce the vibration. The kinematic models are firstly established to evaluate the displacement, velocity and acceleration of the hybrid mechanism. On this basis, a typical trajectory is planned to simulate the movement capabilities of the mechanism by using the trapezoidal acceleration curve motion law. Finally, the effectiveness of the kinematic models is verified by compared the results with those simulated by SolidWorks. The research results of this paper provide a solid foundation to the dimensional synthesis of the hybrid mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on Mediated Control Strategy of Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Hybrid power system has shown good results in the field of vehicle energy saving. However, due to the difficulty in obtaining information such as engine control unit (ECU) core data, it brings great difficulties to the research and development of hybrid vehicles. A mediated control method and strategy of hybrid power system is proposed. The vehicle operation information is adjusted by mediate control unit (MCU) and then sent to ECU, so as to realize the cooperative control between the main power and the secondary power. Researchers only need to obtain the fuel characteristics of the main power source or calibrate them to achieve energy management between the main power source and the secondary energy source. The reasonableness and effectiveness of the proposed intermediate control method are verified by the experimental research on the hydraulic hybrid test bench. This study provides a new way for the development of hybrid electric vehicles and other equipment.

articleTitle: A Crack Detection Model of Wind Turbine Blade Inner Surface Based on Image Fusion Applicable to Embedded Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Timely crack detection is crucial to maintain the health of wind turbine blades. However, the composite structure of the wind turbine blade (WTB) inner surface is intricately composed.
